elements.label: Figure 5.3
elements.title: Line Chart of the S&P 500 Index with the Linear Regression (data source: adapted from S&P 500 [SPX] Historical Data)

details.y-axis label: S&P Index at End of Year
details.trend: Overall upward trend with fluctuations; linear regression line shows steady increase.

elements: This line chart shows the actual S&P 500 index values at the end of each year from 2013 to 2023 along with a linear regression line fitted to the data. It illustrates how the linear regression captures the overall upward trend despite fluctuations in the index values.
